What is the confidence interval on overweight or obese youth (12 to 17, self-reported BMI) in Région de Laval, Quebec, 2021/2022 (percent)?
response_text:
**26.7% – 52.7%** (95% CI), around an estimate of **38.9%**.

All three values carry the `E` flag — *use with caution* — which is unsurprising given the width of the interval (a ±13-point spread on a 38.9% point estimate, reflecting the small 12–17 subsample in a single health region).

Source rows: vectors `v115548668` (estimate), `v115548669` (low), `v115548670` (high), CCHS 2021/2022, Région de Laval (DGUID 2015A00072413).
